ideas.title: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the impact of the Trump administration's decision to pause $259M in funds.
questions: What is the extent of the alleged Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How will the pause in funds affect the Medicaid program?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud in the Medicaid program and highlight the need for increased oversight. I will analyze public records and conduct interviews to shed light on the issue.
